style: Art direction: premium soft 3D clay animation still, like a frame from an award-winning animated short by an international design studio. Match the material, colours and charm of the reference heart mascot image (a red clay heart with green leaves). Setting: Mexico and Latin America; warm, hopeful mood. Composition: wide 16:9 cinematic frame; keep every important subject inside the central 70% of the width because phones crop the sides; keep the top 12% of the frame calm and uncluttered. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, readable signs, logos, watermarks or user-interface elements anywhere in the image.
